title: 36 Hours in Bangkok
abstract: A secret garden, a bicycle ride across city and paddy farms, and a world-class cocktail scene in Thailand’s capital.

title: 36 Hours in New Orleans
abstract: Soak up Mardi Gras season while dive-bar hopping, dancing to brass bands and exploring history in the French Quarter.

title: 36 Hours in Madrid
abstract: A renovated plaza, new hotels and major art exhibitions celebrate Pablo Picasso — just a few more reasons to revisit the Spanish capital.

title: 36 Hours in Miami
abstract: Discover the best of both new and old Miami, from a salsa club in Little Havana to a rooftop bar with striking views of downtown to Cuban American bakeries.
